entries.source: Once inside the dungeon, it is very helpful to take your time with the skeletons and zombies. Two groups at once will be very dangerous to the party. Holy damage is effective, while physical attackers will have trouble due to the many blinding skills. One method is to bring seven heroes with "Charge!"/"Incoming!" and/or "Fall Back!" and stagger their uses in order to run right past the enemies. If the party racks up too much Death Penalty, the zombie groups can be impossible to kill. It's sometimes possible to get past them by creative flagging of henchmen/heroes. Flag your healers off to the sides and a strong tank in front of the first group. Flag the rest of your henchmen on the second group, off to the side so they don't get tangled up in the first group. An alternate way is to take the north side when you reach the breach halfway through the map, because there are only two groups up there and no healers (however there are more warriors to do heavy damage). After half a dozen tries you should be able to pass them and activate the next Resurrection Shrine. Once you activate the second shrine, you can follow the path on the quest map to avoid the remaining mobs all together.
entries.text: 進入地監後，應耐心逐群對付骷髏與殭屍。同時迎戰兩群會使隊伍陷入險境。神聖傷害十分有效，但物理攻擊者會受到大量致盲技能妨礙。一種方法是帶上七名配備「突擊！」、「敵人來襲！」及／或「回防！」的英雄，錯開施放時間，直接跑過敵群。若隊伍累積過多死亡懲罰，殭屍群可能變得無法擊敗。有時可靈活使用隊伍旗幟，安排傭兵與英雄繞過敵人：將治療者安排在兩側，讓耐打的擋怪隊員站在第一群前方，再將其餘傭兵安排在第二群側邊，避免捲入第一群的戰鬥。另一條路線是在抵達地圖中段的缺口時走北側；那裡只有兩群敵人，而且沒有治療者，但戰士較多，傷害也較高。嘗試約六次後，應能突破並啟用下一座復活祭壇。啟用第二座祭壇後，沿任務地圖上的路線前進，即可避開所有剩餘敵群。
entries.reason: 將死刑修正為死亡懲罰；按英文保留七英雄輪替吶喊、旗幟站位與北側替代路線，不將標記誤作攻擊目標。

entries.source: At start, you need to avoid Sokka; turn left, staying in the grass. Cross the tree-trunk bridge by the left kiln and clear the Destroyers occupying the hill including the group waiting to go down to the Eastern kiln. Once you have cleared the green area, you can leave your party just below the last tree on the green side of the hilltop at the edge of the burnt-out spawning grounds. One player must return to Sokka to trigger the kilns, then return to the party to confront the Destroyer spawns that occur within the spawning grounds. Finally, two Bringers of Destruction will appear with assorted other Destroyers. The party should move away and lose aggro at this time; the Destroyers will stay near their spawn point and not chase the party. Defeating the Bringers of Destruction at this point can trigger bugs that make the mission impossible to complete. You can then go talk with Sokka so that he will follow you and offer you Asuran Beacons, which produce a pair of G.O.L.E.M. 1.0s. These golems will follow you, so you can start moving right away. Talk to a golem to switch it between wait- and follow-modes; drop a beacon to replace your golems.
entries.text: 一開始先避開 Sokka，向左轉並留在草地上。穿過左側窯爐旁的樹幹橋，清除佔據山丘的 Destroyers，包括正等候下到東側窯爐的那群。清完綠地後，可將隊伍留在山頂綠地一側、焦黑敵人出現區邊緣的最後一棵樹下。一名玩家返回 Sokka 處啟動窯爐，再回到隊伍，迎戰出現在焦黑區域內的 Destroyers。最後會出現兩名 Bringers of Destruction，以及其他種類的 Destroyers。此時隊伍應後退並脫離敵人警戒範圍；敵人會停在出現位置附近，不會追趕。此時擊敗 Bringers of Destruction 可能觸發錯誤，導致主線任務無法完成。接著與 Sokka 交談，讓他跟隨隊伍並提供 Asuran Beacons；信標可召出一對 G.O.L.E.M. 1.0。這些魔像會跟隨你，因此可立即出發。與魔像交談可切換等待與跟隨模式；放下信標則可替換魔像。
entries.reason: 修正產卵與驅逐艦誤譯；保留暫不擊殺 Bringers 的關鍵失敗條件，以及啟動窯爐、信標與魔像模式的先後順序。

entries.source: After clearing the room, head to the gate. Once you kill the Tremor in front of it, Destroyers will start spawning from the gate, one at a time. You can try to kill the Asura Gate while holding off the Destroyers, or the slower but much easier method is to ignore the gate and kill each Destroyer as it spawns. You should have plenty of time to kill one before the next shows up. After about the 10th Destroyer, they'll stop spawning and you can kill the Asura Gate at your leisure. Or you can completely ignore the mobs that spawn and just attack the gate, it goes down pretty fast and you should get it without dying. Alternatively, if you are having trouble with the Destroyers that spawn in the gate, you can try to pull them right. You can run back to the entrance of the room and they should stay there. Then simply hug the wall and go to the gate and destroy it.
entries.text: 清完房間後前往阿蘇拉傳送門。擊殺門前的 Tremor 後，Destroyers 會從門中逐隻出現。你可以一邊抵擋 Destroyers，一邊摧毀傳送門；較慢但簡單得多的做法是先不攻擊門，逐隻擊殺出現的 Destroyer。下一隻出現前應有足夠時間擊殺前一隻。約第 10 隻之後，敵人便不再出現，屆時可從容摧毀傳送門。也可以完全忽略出現的敵群，直接攻擊門；門很快就會被摧毀，應能在隊伍有人死亡之前完成。如果難以對付門中出現的 Destroyers，另一個辦法是將牠們引向右側，再跑回房間入口，牠們應會留在那裡。然後貼著牆走到門前，將門摧毀即可。
entries.reason: 將 pull them right 校正為向右引怪；完整保留邊打邊拆、清完約第10隻再拆、直接拆門與入口引怪等選項。

entries.source: On the second level, if you do not take Raven blessing, sometimes you will encounter the default mobs instead of Destroyers. On the third level, the Destroyers sometimes do not spawn until you reach the final area that has the Asura Gate. On the third level, if the first Destroyer Tremor isn't attacked by the party the 3 Destroyers that are supposed to protect the second Tremor will almost always remain inactive at their spawn point a bit behind it until they are attacked. If the rest of your party wipes and Ogden and/or Vekk are in the party, they will resurrect where they died, as soon as the final dialogue begins (as you enter the last room).
entries.text: 在第二層，若未接受 Raven blessing，有時會遇到此處原有的敵群，而非 Destroyers。在第三層，Destroyers 有時要等你抵達設有阿蘇拉傳送門的最後區域才會出現。同在第三層，若隊伍未攻擊第一隻 Destroyer Tremor，原本負責保護第二隻 Tremor 的 3 隻 Destroyers 幾乎都會停在其後方不遠處的出現位置，直到受到攻擊才會行動。若其餘隊員全滅，而 Ogden 及／或 Vekk 在隊伍中，當你進入最後一間房間、最終對話開始時，他們就會在死亡的位置復活。
entries.reason: 修正抹掉與產卵等字面誤譯；保留未攻擊第一隻 Tremor 的被動條件，以及最終對話使 Ogden、Vekk 原地復活的觸發時機。

entries.source: Plow your way through some basic cave critters to make your way to Renk and Sokka then fend off the nearby destroyers. Oola will alert the party of a missing Vanguard group nearby. You'll find Captain Langmar a short way away accompanied by Chance Redding and Jenn Valefield. Continuing west, you'll see a number of Vanguard groups engaged with destroyers. You can try to save them, but the destroyers will likely kill them. South, you'll see a large battle between the Vanguard and destroyers. Again, the odds are stacked in favor of the destroyers, so it's often best to simply rush to the zone on the other side of the room while the Vanguard have the Destroyers occupied.
entries.text: 擊敗沿路的普通洞穴生物，抵達 Renk 與 Sokka 處，再擊退附近的 Destroyers。Oola 會告知隊伍，附近有一支先鋒隊失蹤了。往前不遠便能找到隊長連瑪，Chance Redding 與 Jenn Valefield 也在她身旁。繼續向西，可見數支先鋒隊正與 Destroyers 交戰。你可以嘗試救援，但他們很可能仍會被 Destroyers 殺死。往南會看到先鋒隊與 Destroyers 的大規模戰鬥。Destroyers 仍佔有優勢，因此通常最好趁先鋒隊牽制敵人時，直接衝向房間另一端的區域出口。
entries.reason: 將先鋒隊佔領驅逐艦修正為牽制 Destroyers；依原文保留西向救援與南向趁戰鬥通過出口的路線。

entries.source: Level 2: Here, you'll have to reactivate the golems. A short way outside, you'll see dryders and destroyers. These groups will battle if they come within aggro range of each other. Try to run by the second group of dryders on your way to the Norn. Once at the Norn, Destroyers will start coming in from multiple fronts. Taking them all on at the same time may be tricky, but if you position yourself away from the center (where the quest marker is), you can avoid aggro with half the assault group until you're ready for them. Another tactic is to let the golems die along the bridge, blocking the path, and thus protecting you from the Destroyers' deadly warriors and dervishes while you attack with arrows and spells. Once the assault is over, follow Olaf Olafson to where he will open a door. Follow this path, fight a few more Destroyers, and enter the portal by the Stone Dwarves into the Central Transfer Chamber. Don't spend too much time with Dwarves, or you will be caught up with large swarm of Destroyers which have followed your trails.
entries.text: 第 2 層：此處需要重新啟動魔像。向外走不遠便會看到 Dryders 與 Destroyers；兩群進入彼此的警戒範圍時會互相交戰。前往諾恩處時，盡量跑過第二群 Dryders。抵達諾恩處後，Destroyers 會從多個方向進攻。同時迎戰所有敵人並不容易；若站在中央任務標記以外的位置，便可暫不引到約半數的進攻敵人，待準備好再接戰。另一種戰術是讓魔像死在橋上，以身體阻擋通道；如此可一面用弓箭與法術攻擊，一面避開 Destroyers 中致命的戰士與神喚使。攻勢結束後，跟隨歐拉夫 歐拉夫森到他開門的位置。沿路再擊敗幾群 Destroyers，從石矮人旁的傳送門進入 Central Transfer Chamber。不要在矮人身旁停留太久，否則沿著隊伍路線追來的大群 Destroyers 會趕上你。
entries.reason: 修正 Dryders、警戒與身體阻擋的戰術語義；保留魔像橋上死亡、歐拉夫開門和追兵限制，不把神喚使泛譯為德魯伊。

entries.source: Note that this method can be used, with slight modification, to easily gain mission and bonus. Have two people run crystals, the second waiting by the crystal spawn point to pick it up the moment the other has attuned a pedestal. It is important that these two do not attune the last pedestal until the bonus is gained. A third person, or the rest of the party, kills the Demagogue. This can easily be done by following the south wall, you should not need to kill any White Mantle other than him if you take this path. Now the most important part: do not aggro the White Mantle runners. Two non-buffed runners can easily keep the portals attuned without hindering the White Mantle. If a third human player is not present, then this method can be done using only two. The Demagogue slayer (with the bulk of the team) retraces steps and becomes the second runner after the bonus has been gained.
entries.text: 稍作調整後，這個方法也能輕鬆同時取得主線任務與額外獎勵。安排兩人運送水晶；第二人留在水晶出現處，等第一人調諧基座後立即拾取新水晶。取得額外獎勵之前，這兩人絕不可調諧最後一座基座。第三人或其餘隊員負責擊殺煽動者。沿南牆前進便能輕鬆到達，走這條路應不必擊殺他以外的白斗篷。最重要的是，不要引到白斗篷的水晶搬運者。兩名未附加增益效果的運送者，就能在不妨礙白斗篷的情況下維持傳送門的調諧。若沒有第三名真人玩家，兩人也能使用此法：負責擊殺煽動者的玩家帶著隊伍主力，先取得額外獎勵，再沿原路折返，改任第二名水晶運送者。
entries.reason: 保留最後基座須等額外獎勵的時序；將 non-buffed 校正為未附加增益，並明確區分玩家運送者與不可引到的白斗篷搬運者。

entries.source: The Morale Boost granted upon killing a Sand Giant also affects animal companions. In the last round, Lyssha Suss's (Custodian Phebus's) team may be tagged as Defeated without even having been engaged. If this happens, the player can ignore this group and finish the mission by just killing the other two teams. Sometimes, a chest will spawn at the entrance to Issah Sshay's chamber which the Ghostly Hero may become stuck on. If this happens the team must resign and begin the mission again. If you pull enemies to the Ghostly Hero before he opens the first gate, he may spend too long fighting them and never open the gate.
entries.text: 擊殺沙巨人所獲得的士氣提升也會影響動物夥伴。最後一輪中，Lyssha Suss（Custodian Phebus）的隊伍可能尚未交戰就被標記為已擊敗。遇到此情況時，可忽略該隊，只擊殺另外兩隊便能完成主線任務。有時依沙席房間的入口會出現寶箱，英雄之魂可能因此卡住；這時全隊必須使用 /resign 放棄，重新開始主線任務。在英雄之魂打開第一道門之前，若將敵人引到他身旁，他可能因戰鬥耗時過久而再也不開門。
entries.reason: 修正士氣效果與英雄之魂卡門條件；保留未交戰即判敗的替代完成方法，以及必須放棄重開的例外。

entries.source: This room has no environmental effect. Instead, you'll fight swarms of Crystal Spiders, with Forgotten Illusionists backing them up. The spiders spam Shatter Enchantment and Hex Breaker, so be wary of hex and enchantment usage. Some of the Illusionists hide behind solid crystal walls that do not hinder their indirect spells, but which shield them from melee and projectile assault. As such, a few strong indirect spells of your own are useful here, but be sure to watch out for their Chaos Storm. It's worth taking the time to destroy them with spells before engaging new groups of spiders, because together these opponents can present a tough battle, especially in hard mode. The back of the room has a twisted path leading to the Facet of Chaos. Pairs of Illusionists will cast across the low walls of the path, but projectile attacks can reach them.
entries.text: 這間房間沒有環境效果。你會迎戰成群的 Crystal Spiders，並有被遺忘者幻術師在後方支援。蜘蛛會頻繁施放「加持粉碎」與「破咒頌歌」，使用降咒與加持魔法時務必留意。有些幻術師躲在實心水晶牆後；牆不會阻擋其非投射物法術，卻能擋住肉搏與投射物攻擊。因此，攜帶幾個強力的非投射物法術很有幫助，但仍要提防對方的「混沌風暴」。在迎戰新的蜘蛛群之前，值得先花時間用法術消滅幻術師；兩者同時進攻會使戰鬥相當棘手，尤其在困難模式。房間後方有條曲折小路，通往渾沌之分身。幻術師會兩人一組隔著小路的矮牆施法，但投射物攻擊仍能命中他們。
entries.reason: 校正房間沒有環境效果、降咒與非投射物法術；區分實心高牆的遮擋與小路矮牆仍可被投射物命中的差異。

entries.source: A little while after the first Stone Summit group the mob of Mursaat passes on the frozen lake, there is a Shiverpeak Chest which the Mursaat sometimes will get stuck on and stop moving. If this happens, you will have to retry the mission or attempt to have an infused player pull them away from it. The Mursaat stops after the stone bridge. Sometimes Evennia will not follow you; sometimes she may follow Saidra and gets killed by Mursaat; you must restart the mission if this happens. Sometimes Rornak Stonesledge will not be at his location, making it impossible to claim the bonus without restarting the mission. Occasionally, a stray barrage from the siege weapons will land near the spawn of Virag Bladestone, harming the party. The Mursaat are not hostile to Darda Goldenchief's group. Sometimes, a Shiverpeak Chest will spawn in an unreachable location near the ice boat siege engines.
entries.text: 馬賽特敵群通過第一群石峰矮人後不久，會經過結冰湖面上的 Shiverpeak Chest；牠們有時會卡在寶箱旁而停止移動。遇到此情況，必須重試主線任務，或嘗試由護甲已灌注的玩家將牠們引離寶箱。馬賽特通過石橋後會停下。有時伊凡妮雅不會跟隨隊伍，或會跟著 Saidra 而被馬賽特殺死；發生後者時必須重開主線任務。有時洛奈科斯通萊基不在原位，若不重開就無法取得額外獎勵。偶爾攻城武器的流彈會落在刃岩畢拉克出現處附近，傷及隊伍。馬賽特不會敵視金首達勒塔的隊伍。有時 Shiverpeak Chest 會出現在冰船攻城武器附近、玩家無法抵達的位置。
entries.reason: 將 infused player 校正為護甲已灌注的玩家；逐項保留寶箱卡怪、伊凡妮雅跟隨、NPC缺席、攻城流彈與不可達寶箱的例外。

entries.source: When Deldrimor declares war, waves of Stone Summit and Jade constructs start spawning and approaching the fort. After 2 minutes and 15 seconds, a Stone Summit boss group spawns. When this entire group dies, Jalis says "The Mantle followed you! Stand fast friends! This will be our finest hour!". Waves of White Mantle start spawning to the north of the fort, and Jade constructs near the teleporter further to the north. After exactly 3 minutes, a Mursaat boss group spawns. When this entire group dies, Jalis says "Be on your guard. The left hand of Grenth himself comes for us.". Waves of Mursaat start spawning near the teleporter. After 9 minutes and 40 seconds, Confessor Dorian and a group of White Mantle spawn near the teleporter. They take a strange route to the fort, stopping for a while to the north-east before turning back and entering through the west. Kill this entire group and then talk to Jalis to complete the mission.
entries.text: 戴爾狄摩宣戰後，石峰矮人與 Jade constructs 會一波接一波出現並逼近堡壘。經過 2 分 15 秒，會出現一群石峰矮人頭目及隨從。必須殺光整群，Jalis 才會說：「白斗篷跟著你們來了！朋友們，守住！這將是我們最光榮的一刻！」接著，白斗篷會從堡壘北面接連出現，Jade constructs 則出現在更北面的傳送門附近。再經過整整 3 分鐘，會出現一群馬賽特頭目及隨從。殺光整群後，Jalis 會說：「提高警覺。古蘭斯本人的左手正朝我們而來。」隨後馬賽特會在傳送門附近接連出現。經過 9 分 40 秒，大主教多利安與一群白斗篷會出現在傳送門附近。他們前往堡壘的路線很奇怪，會先在東北面停留片刻，再折返並從西面進入。殺光整群，再與 Jalis 交談，即可完成主線任務。
entries.reason: 依英文保留三階段整群擊殺後才推進的條件與2分15秒、3分鐘、9分40秒，不擅自將時間改為任務累計時間。

entries.source: You lose this mission (and bonus) by getting worn down. The Kournans and Margonites are fighting a war of attrition against you - you have very little time to recuperate between battles as you constantly need to be fighting somewhere else. That means your team needs to be relatively self-sufficient - bring a self-heal and something to help you regenerate energy quickly. The longer the mission goes on, the harder it will get as death penalty starts to rack up and you have no reserves left you will find it harder to eliminate groups quick enough and you'll find yourself overwhelmed. Consequently, end it as soon as possible - be ready to eliminate at least one general the moment they spawn. While this is a tough mission, well-equipped teams shouldn't have too much trouble.
entries.text: 這個主線任務及其額外獎勵，會因隊伍逐漸被消耗而失敗。高楠軍與瑪骨奈正對你進行消耗戰；你必須不停趕往別處作戰，兩場戰鬥之間幾乎沒有恢復時間。因此，隊員需要具備一定的自給能力，攜帶自我治療與快速恢復能量的手段。任務拖得越久，死亡懲罰便越積越多，備用資源也會耗盡，使你難以及時消滅敵群，最後被壓倒。因此應盡快結束任務，準備在將軍出現的當下就擊殺其中至少一名。雖然任務困難，裝備完善的隊伍應不至於遇到太大問題。
entries.reason: 將死刑修正為死亡懲罰；還原高楠軍與瑪骨奈消耗戰、自我恢復及將軍剛出現時至少擊殺一名的因果。

entries.source: Start from Unwaking Waters (Luxon), hug the west (left) wall towards the boats, and flag your team near the Mob (3) spawn point. Pull the starting Mob (1); once eliminated, use speed boosts to swiftly aggro Mob (2) that spawns near/behind one of the further boats before it moves to the center. After these are killed, Mob (3) will spawn behind you, near the original flag-point. Mob (4) will spawn right behind the boat that's closest to you. The last group, Mob (5), spawn relatively far away to the east of your likely location, but will move towards the boats before moving towards the center. After killing this group, the quest should be completed.
entries.text: 從 Unwaking Waters（勒克森）出發，沿西側（左側）牆壁走向船隻，將隊伍旗幟放在敵群（3）的出現處附近。先引來起始敵群（1），消滅後使用加速技能，趕在敵群（2）移往中央之前引到牠們；牠們會出現在較遠的一艘船旁或船後。殺光後，敵群（3）會出現在你的後方、原先旗幟位置附近。敵群（4）會緊接著出現在離你最近的船後。最後的敵群（5）出現在你可能所在位置以東較遠處，但會先往船隻移動，再前往中央。消滅這群後，任務應會完成。
entries.reason: 逐一保留敵群（1）至（5）的出現與移動順序；明確區分西牆旗點、遠船、近船與東側最後一群。

entries.source: The final battle takes place in the Harvest Temple against Enraged Kuunavang alone. Melee characters will finally be able to attack the dragon, but there is no room to maneuver and both parties will be at risk of her massive AoE damage skills, so put up protection skills as quickly as possible. Keep spread out and try to interrupt as many of her skills as possible. If she summons Corrupted Scale creatures, eliminate them before returning your attention to the dragon; you will need to call them as targets, otherwise heroes and henchmen from both sides will ignore them. Leaders of henchmen-only parties should be prepared to flag and re-flag their party repeatedly to keep them out of harm's way.
entries.text: 最後一戰在豐收神殿進行，敵人只有 Enraged Kuunavang。肉搏角色終於能攻擊這條龍，但場內沒有多少移動空間，兩支隊伍都會受到她高傷害範圍技能的威脅，因此應盡快施放保護技能。保持分散，並盡量中斷她的技能。若她召出 Corrupted Scale，先消滅牠們，再轉回攻擊龍；務必呼叫牠們為目標，否則雙方的英雄與傭兵都會忽略牠們。只帶傭兵的隊長，應準備反覆使用隊伍旗幟調整站位，讓隊員避開傷害。
entries.reason: 保留兩支隊伍皆受範圍傷害、呼叫 Corrupted Scale 才使英雄傭兵攻擊，以及全傭兵隊長反覆改旗避傷的操作。

entries.source: The foes in this mission have hex removal skills (Shiro'ken Monks have Reverse Hex and Shiro'ken Mesmers have Shatter Hex), but lack condition removal, so consider bringing skills that inflict conditions instead of hex spells. Consider bringing hex spells with an end effect that triggers when removed by a hex removal skill, such as Phantom Pain.
entries.text: 這個主線任務的敵人具有移除降咒的技能：白影軍團僧侶會使用「降咒反轉」，白影軍團幻術師會使用「降咒粉碎」；但他們缺乏移除病症的手段，因此可考慮攜帶施加病症的技能，取代降咒魔法。也可選擇被移除降咒技能解除時，會觸發結束效果的降咒魔法，例如「痛苦幻影」。
entries.reason: 明確區分病症與降咒；修正痛苦幻影的角色，它是被移除時觸發結束效果的降咒，而非移除降咒的技能。

entries.source:
The Ghost of Sehwanu spawns randomly — empirically at a rate of roughly 5% (i.e. about one time in twenty). When she does spawn, she will be staring out to sea on the beach behind Bloodback Morrob and his cultists.
She is guaranteed to spawn for any member of the party due to receive the reward after killing Wianuyo - this can remove the random element of her spawning for picking up the quest.
entries.text: Ghost of Sehwanu 會隨機出現；依實測，機率約為 5%，也就是約二十次中有一次。她出現時，會在 Bloodback Morrob 及其教徒後方的海灘上望向大海。若隊伍中有人已擊殺 Wianuyo、正等待領取獎勵，她就保證會出現；利用這個條件，可免去為接取任務而等待她隨機出現的不確定性。
entries.reason: 保留5%與約二十分之一的同義機率；明確說明保證出現的對象是隊內已殺 Wianuyo 並等待獎勵者。

entries.source: From Jokanur Diggings, enter Fahranur, The First City and move forward a little to get the quest objective to update. The rest of the quest is accomplished by simply following the quest marker to find five different interactive objects. In order, your character needs to examine two sets of Weathered Bones, an Old Chest, a Rusty Chest, and a Loose Rock. At each location, several hostile insects will spawn, but they are easily dispatched.
entries.text: 從 Jokanur Diggings 進入舊城 法蘭努爾，向前走一小段，讓任務目標更新。接下來只需跟隨任務標記，找到五個可互動物件。角色須依序檢查兩組 Weathered Bones、一個 Old Chest、一個 Rusty Chest，以及一塊 Loose Rock。每處都會出現數隻敵對昆蟲，但很容易擊敗。
entries.reason: 還原五個物件的計數：兩組骸骨加三種不同物件；保留檢查順序與各處出現昆蟲的條件。

entries.source: Whether you choose to fight or run, another Kournan ambush waits to the east, at the quest marker. Pulling the mobs toward the small bridge can help prevent over-aggro (and/or getting hit by Kournan siege fire from Gandara.) After the second set of Kournan mobs are killed, Nerashi will again advise the party to retreat. As before, you can choose to fight the incoming soldiers, or just run to the next quest marker right outside of Pogahn Passage.
entries.text: 無論選擇戰鬥或跑過，東側任務標記處仍有另一場高楠軍伏擊。將敵群引向小橋，有助於避免引到過多敵人，也能避開來自 Gandara 的高楠攻城砲火。擊殺第二批高楠敵群後，Nerashi 會再次建議隊伍撤退。與先前相同，你可以迎戰追來的士兵，也可直接跑到波甘驛站外的下一個任務標記。
entries.reason: 保留第二次伏擊、向小橋引怪的雙重目的，以及擊殺後仍可選擇作戰或跑往波甘驛站的分支。

entries.source: Once all three groups have been eliminated, continue back east and defeat the soldiers that spawn near the fortress. Scout the path back to Pogahn Passage, clearing any stray Kournans, then return to Nerashi to take the quest.
entries.text: 消滅三群敵人後，繼續向東折返，擊敗堡壘附近出現的士兵。偵察返回波甘驛站的路線，清除沿途零散的高楠軍，再回到 Nerashi 處接取任務。
entries.reason: 修正末尾為接取任務而非交付任務；保留先清三群、東返清堡旁士兵，再清回程的順序。

entries.source: Hex spells are not used by any of the foes in this area.
entries.text: 本區的所有敵人都不使用降咒魔法。
entries.reason: 將十六進位字面誤譯修正為遊戲技能類型降咒魔法，保留本區所有敵人的限定範圍。

entries.source: Although Ash Blast is a hex spell, the hex is only applied to Burning foes. None of the foes in this area can apply Burning, so you would have to apply it to yourself.
entries.text: 「塵暴」雖然是降咒魔法，卻只會對燃燒中的敵人附加降咒。本區沒有敵人能使你燃燒，因此若要讓自己受到這個降咒，必須先使自己燃燒。
entries.reason: 保留塵暴只對燃燒目標附加降咒的條件；釐清後句須自行使自己燃燒，而非為敵人施加燃燒。

entries.source: Wells and Wards are helpful, since you're going to be in the same general area the entire time.
entries.text: 由於整段戰鬥都會停留在同一片區域，湧泉魔法與結界魔法很有幫助。
entries.reason: 將 Wells、Wards 校正為湧泉魔法與結界魔法；保留固定駐守區域使它們有效的原因。

entries.source: Whiteout is on a circular cliff towards the north of Jaga Moraine. As you approach, a massive ice boulder rolls down the path. It kills anyone in its way, but there is room to step aside if you act quickly. Note that you do not get a death penalty from the ice boulder.
entries.text: Whiteout 位於 Jaga Moraine 北面的環形懸崖上。接近時，一塊巨大的冰石會沿小路滾下，殺死路徑上的所有人；只要反應夠快，仍有空間可側身躲開。被冰石殺死不會受到死亡懲罰。
entries.reason: 修正即死冰石與死亡懲罰的遊戲語義；保留北側環崖位置、可迅速側避及不加懲罰。

entries.source: Lok The Mischievous's fiery boulders will kill you instantly if you are struck by them, although they do not cause any Death Penalty.
entries.text: 被 Lok The Mischievous 的火焰巨石擊中會立即死亡，但不會受到死亡懲罰。
entries.reason: 將死刑誤譯修正為死亡懲罰；保留命中立即死亡與不加懲罰的兩個獨立結果。

entries.source: In the final room there are many spiders, from Level 14 Spiders to Lifeweavers of Level 24, and it is recommended to kill all of the spiders before starting to burn the eggs because of the pop ups. There are ten clutches of eggs to burn, in two groups of five on either side of the chamber. Burning all five clutches on one side causes a large group of spiders including a Spider Matriarch to spawn, and after you've burned the last clutch of eggs, Arachni spawns with another large group. You have to kill the matriarch and Arachni to complete the quest and reveal Arachni's Spoils; it doesn't matter which one you kill first.
entries.text: 最後一間房間有許多蜘蛛，從 14 級的 Spiders 到 24 級的 Lifeweavers 都有。由於還有伏兵，建議先殺光現有蜘蛛，再開始焚燒卵。總共有十窩卵要燒，房間兩側各五窩。燒完其中一側的五窩，便會出現包含 Spider Matriarch 的一大群蜘蛛；燒完最後一窩後，奧拉赫妮會帶著另一大群蜘蛛出現。必須擊殺 Spider Matriarch 與奧拉赫妮，才能完成任務並讓 Arachni's Spoils 出現；兩者的擊殺先後不限。
entries.reason: 保留14與24級、兩側各五窩共十窩及兩次伏兵觸發；明確兩名頭目均須擊殺，但先後不限。

entries.source: The A Prescription for Conscription quest in particular will produce a lot more insect spawns.
entries.text: 尤其是 A Prescription for Conscription 任務，會使出現的昆蟲敵人多出許多。
entries.reason: 將 insect spawns 校正為昆蟲敵人出現的數量，避免誤作昆蟲產卵；未證實任務中文名保留英文。

entries.source: This area does not contribute to the Elonian Cartographer title track because it is considered underground (i.e. not uncovered on the world map).
entries.text: 此區被視為地下區域，不會揭開世界地圖，因此不計入 Elonian Cartographer 頭銜的進度。
entries.reason: 區分地下區域、世界地圖揭露與頭銜進度的因果，不將 title track 誤譯為主打歌。

entries.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.6% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
entries.text: 完整探索此區，約可增加 2.6% 的 Elonian Cartographer 頭銜進度。
entries.reason: 校正為探索頭銜進度並保留約2.6%；無固定中文證據的完整頭銜名保留英文。

entries.source: Elementalist ward spells that cover the gate, or Necromancer wells that buff the party (or debuff the enemies) can be very useful on this quest. Good use of aggro and body blocking may also enable use of area of effect spells to quickly wipe out the Margonites.
entries.text: 元素使可用結界魔法覆蓋入口，死靈法師則可用湧泉魔法增益隊友或削弱敵人；這些技能在本任務都很有用。善用引怪與身體阻擋，也能配合範圍法術迅速消滅瑪骨奈。
entries.reason: 修正結界與湧泉的技能類型，並保留對友增益、對敵削弱，以及引怪和身體阻擋配合範圍傷害的戰術。

entries.source: Head out into the Domain of Secrets and make your way to Terick situated due west. When you find him, he will make a short taunting speech, turn hostile and attack the party. Upon his defeat, Terick will respawn as the demonic necromancer boss, Razakel. Once Razakel is defeated, return to the Gate of Secrets for your reward.
entries.text: 進入奧秘領地（奧秘之門外），向正西方的 Terick 前進。找到他後，他會說幾句嘲諷的話，轉為敵對並攻擊隊伍。擊敗 Terick 後，他會以惡魔死靈法師頭目 Razakel 的形態重新出現。擊敗 Razakel，再返回 Gate of Secrets 領取獎勵。
entries.reason: 保留 Terick 嘲諷後轉敵對、敗後化為 Razakel 及再次擊敗後回城領獎的先後條件。

entries.source: Destroy the Demon Underlords to release the magical bindings placed on the entrance to the spawning tunnels. 0...2 of 2 Demon Underlords remain.
entries.text: 消滅 Demon Underlords，解除施加在 spawning tunnels 入口上的魔法束縛。還剩 0...2 名 Demon Underlords，總共 2 名。
entries.reason: 保留0...2 of 2動態計數；魔法束縛作用於隧道入口，未以無證據的產卵隧道冒充地名翻譯。

entries.source: The four Stygian Lords are each at a different place in the area. Each trench has a few hidden spawns that will ambush the party. Upon entering any trench and getting near the half-way point, a large spawn of melee creatures will appear at either end of the trench and then run to the opposite side (sandwiching whoever is inside). Also, one or two Tormentor demons will spawn on the two cliffs overlooking the trench. It's recommended that the party have someone go in and trigger this spawn first before they enter the trench. This player can either just die in there and get Rebirthed from the cliff above or they can use a teleportation skill like Recall to return to their party members.
entries.text: 四名 Stygian Lords 各自位於區內不同地點。每條溝槽都藏有會伏擊隊伍的敵人。進入任一溝槽並接近中段時，兩端會各出現一大群肉搏敵人，跑向另一端，夾擊槽內的人。此外，俯瞰溝槽的兩側懸崖上也會出現一兩隻 Tormentor demons。建議先派一名隊員進入觸發伏兵，其餘人再進溝槽。這名隊員可以死在裡面，由上方懸崖的隊友施放「重生」復活；也可使用「回歸」等傳送技能回到隊友身邊。
entries.reason: 還原溝槽兩端對向夾擊與崖上伏兵；明確先派一人觸發，以及由上方施放重生或用回歸返隊的兩個選項。

entries.source: An elementalist with a large hidden spawn in the alcove he is found in.
entries.text: 一名元素使；他所在的凹室內藏有大量伏兵。
entries.reason: 將 hidden spawn 校正為隱藏伏兵，保留元素使所在凹室的空間關係，避免產卵誤譯。

entries.source: After aggroing Ilsundur, Lord of Fire, 2 lava boulders will appear: One lava boulder travels clockwise around the inner perimeter and the other counterclockwise around the outer perimeter, so flag heroes not engaged in melee in between. Like other boulders they will instantly kill a player (but will not inflict death penalty).
entries.text: 引到火之主 音喪多後，會出現 2 塊熔岩巨石：一塊沿內圈順時針移動，另一塊沿外圈逆時針移動。因此，應用旗幟將未參與肉搏的英雄安排在兩圈之間。如同其他巨石，熔岩巨石會立即殺死玩家，但不會施加死亡懲罰。
entries.reason: 完整保留兩塊巨石的內外圈及相反方向；釐清非肉搏英雄站位與巨石即死但不加死亡懲罰。

entries.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.5% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
entries.text: 完整探索此區，約可增加 2.5% 的 Elonian Cartographer 頭銜進度。
entries.reason: 校正探索頭銜進度並保留約2.5%；完整頭銜名缺乏固定中文證據，保留英文。

entries.source: The Crushers seem to only kill you and the Frost Golems, but do not give any Death Penalty.
entries.text: Crushers 似乎只會殺死玩家與 Frost Golems，而且不會造成死亡懲罰。
entries.reason: 保留英文似乎的不確定語氣與僅影響玩家、Frost Golems 的範圍，校正死亡懲罰。

entries.source: Upon entrance, the area map is on your right. Since approaching the Siege Wurm causes another Frost Wurm to spawn, carefully pulling the Incubi and the Mandragors away from the wurms is recommended. It's possible to hide behind the ice to prevent the Siege Wurm from hitting you while you bring down the other wurm. Past the ice bridge, a Frostmaw Spawn will popup so it's best to pull the Mandragors across the bridge and dispatch them separately. Run to the right past the Icy Stalagmite into the next chamber and ignore the Siege Wurms if you can. From the next doorway, a group of Siege Wurms are visible, accompanied by Mandragors. Lure the Mandragors away, and kill them while out of range of the Siege Wurms. Next, a group of Jotun are guarding the path to the Level 5 entrance. You need to pull the Jotun away from their post since a Frostmaw Spawn and one or more, Frost Wurms popup and aggro with them. It is best to attack from the hillside to the right of the Jotun spawn. Finally, the gate itself is guarded by two Icy Stalagmites.
entries.text: 進入後，區域地圖就在右側。接近 Siege Wurm 會使另一隻 Frost Wurm 出現，因此建議小心將 Incubi 與 Mandragors 引離地蟲。擊殺其中一隻地蟲時，可躲在冰塊後方，避免被 Siege Wurm 命中。冰橋後方會突然出現 Frostmaw Spawn，因此最好先將 Mandragors 引過橋，分開消滅。向右跑過 Icy Stalagmite，進入下一間房間；能避開 Siege Wurms 就避開。從下一個門口可看見一群 Siege Wurms，旁邊還有 Mandragors。先引走 Mandragors，在 Siege Wurms 的攻擊距離外殺死牠們。接著，一群 Jotun 會守住通往第 5 層入口的路。必須將 Jotun 引離原位，因為一隻 Frostmaw Spawn 與一隻或更多 Frost Wurms 會突然出現，與牠們一同進攻。最好從 Jotun 出現位置右側的山坡發動攻擊。最後，門本身還有兩隻 Icy Stalagmites 把守。
entries.reason: 逐步還原地蟲伏兵、隔冰掩護、過橋分怪與右坡進攻；Frostmaw Spawn 保留為敵人名稱，不誤譯為生成者。

entries.source: Frostmaw does not regenerate health; you can keep whittling her down even after accumulating a high Death Penalty.
entries.text: Frostmaw 不會自動再生體力；即使累積很高的死亡懲罰，仍能持續一點一點削減她的體力。
entries.reason: 限於原文不自動再生體力的機制，不擴大成無法被治療；保留高死亡懲罰下仍可逐步磨掉體力。

entries.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.8% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
entries.text: 完整探索此區，約可增加 2.8% 的 Elonian Cartographer 頭銜進度。
entries.reason: 校正探索頭銜進度並保留約2.8%；未證實完整中文頭銜名保留英文。

entries.source: Beware of the central area on this map where two groups of Skeleton Mesmers and Damned Clerics are packed together with Zombie Warlocks. The warlocks stand on a slope where they can comfortably spawn bone minions each time you kill a foe. If you are coming from one of the exits to the Black Curtain, it is advisable to run past this mob and approach it from the other side, where you can engage the warlocks alone and retain a height advantage over the mesmers and clerics. Note that if your party is wiped when you are a bit further from the group, you will resurrect at the shrine close to the exit to Nebo Terrace - which is not an altogether unwise strategy if you can spare the death penalty.
entries.text: 小心地圖中央；兩群骷髏幻術師、地獄牧師與殭屍法魔密集聚在那裡。殭屍法魔站在斜坡上，每當你殺死一名敵人，就能輕易利用屍體召喚骸骨小兵。如果從通往黑色帷幕的任一出口前來，建議先跑過這群敵人，再從另一側接近；如此可單獨迎戰殭屍法魔，並對幻術師與牧師保有高度優勢。注意，若在距離敵群稍遠處全隊陣亡，便會在尼伯山丘出口附近的祭壇復活。只要能承受死亡懲罰，這也不失為一種策略。
entries.reason: 使用固定證據中的三種敵人名稱；修正屍體召喚、反面單清與高度優勢，並保留承受死亡懲罰才適用的復活捷徑。

entries.source: The bosses in this area have Elite skills that are not regularly available in this area. Utilizing a Signet of Capture may also help with Death Penalty reduction.
entries.text: 本區的頭目帶有平常無法在此區取得的精英技能。使用「捕捉紋章」也有助於減輕死亡懲罰。
entries.reason: 將精英技能取得與死亡懲罰減輕分清；不將 Signet 泛譯為標誌，也不擴大技能在其他區域的可得性。

entries.source: Stopping the damage from the Earth, Water & Wind Born Titans is the key to success. To achieve this, defensive skills like Protective Spirit, "Save Yourselves!" and Shelter, and offensive shutdown like Panic or daze are a good idea since the majority of the threat is from casters.
entries.text: 阻止 Earth Born Titans、Water Born Titans 與 Wind Born Titans 造成傷害，是成功的關鍵。由於主要威脅來自施法者，可使用「精神守護」、「Save Yourselves!」與「庇護」等防禦技能，或用「恐慌」、暈眩等手段壓制敵人施法。
entries.reason: 修正地球破壞、腳輪與發呆等字面誤譯；明確三種 Titans 的傷害、施法者威脅與暈眩壓制的關係。

entries.source: Once you kill the Reaper of Destruction on level 2, your route to the exit will fill with spawns of destroyers.
entries.text: 在第 2 層擊殺 Reaper of Destruction 後，通往出口的路上會出現大量 Destroyers。
entries.reason: 將 spawns 校正為敵人出現；保留第2層擊殺指定敵人後，出口路線才充滿 Destroyers 的觸發。

entries.source: If you are having trouble, you can run away from the destroyers and wait for nearby ice traps or remaining foes to weaken the groups enough for you to finish off the rest.
entries.text: 若難以應付，可先遠離 Destroyers，等待附近的冰陷阱或其餘敵人削弱牠們，再回頭消滅殘餘的 Destroyers。
entries.reason: 釐清被冰陷阱與其餘敵人削弱的是 Destroyers，並非玩家隊伍；保留退避後收尾的戰術。

entries.source: Destroyers are resistant to fire damage and immune to Burning. Several foes here (Elementals and Nightmares) are not fleshy.
entries.text: Destroyers 能抵抗火焰傷害，且免疫燃燒。本區有些敵人（Elementals 與 Nightmares）不屬於血肉生物。
entries.reason: 將 not fleshy 校正為非血肉生物的遊戲分類；分別保留抗火焰傷害與免疫燃燒兩項性質。

entries.source: The quest log could update itself as "Completed" after killing the waves of Destroyers but not the Plague of Destruction.
entries.text: 擊殺數波 Destroyers 後，即使尚未擊殺疫之破壞者，任務日誌也可能自行顯示為「已完成」。
entries.reason: 修正完成狀態的條件：清完波次但頭目尚未死仍可能完成，不將頭目名當成日誌應更新的狀態文字。

entries.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.2% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
entries.text: 完整探索此區，約可增加 3.2% 的 Elonian Cartographer 頭銜進度。
entries.reason: 校正探索頭銜進度並保留約3.2%；無固定完整中文頭銜名，保留英文。

entries.source: Reclaim the Asura Gate to the Central Transfer Chamber from the Destroyers in the Depths of Tyria.
entries.text: 從泰瑞亞深處的 Destroyers 手中，奪回通往 Central Transfer Chamber 的阿蘇拉傳送門。
entries.reason: 釐清傳送門目的地、所在地與佔領者；不將 Destroyers 誤譯為驅逐艦。

entries.source: Gather 3 Destroyer Cores. You have [3...0] of 3 left to collect.
entries.text: 收集 3 個 Destroyer Cores。總共 3 個，目前尚需收集 [3...0] 個。
entries.reason: 完整保留3個總數與[3...0]倒數占位；清楚表示尚待收集，而非已收集數量。

entries.source: If arriving from Ascalon Foothills, take note that sometimes a group of hydra (4 or 5) will spawn at that exit a few minutes after the map has loaded. If this happens and they were not intercepted, they will run all way to the Flame Temple Corridor exit, passing by in front of Grendich Courthouse. Upon arrival, they have been reported to either patrol (possibly as 2 groups) to and from the exits, or linger at the Flame Temple Corridor exit.
entries.text: 如果從阿斯卡隆丘陵進入，請留意：地圖載入數分鐘後，有時會在該出口出現一群三頭龍（4 或 5 隻）。若未加攔截，牠們會從葛蘭迪法院前方經過，一路跑到夏爾火焰神殿出口。據回報，抵達後牠們可能在各出口之間來回巡邏（也可能分成 2 群），或留在夏爾火焰神殿出口附近。
entries.reason: 依詞典使用三頭龍；保留載圖數分鐘、4或5隻、可能分2群，以及巡邏或留守的報告性語氣。

entries.source: The Afflicted Mei will despawn immediately after spawning.
entries.text: The Afflicted Mei 出現後會立即消失。
entries.reason: 將 spawn 與 despawn 的相反狀態譯為出現後立即消失；專名缺乏固定中文證據，保留英文。

entries.source: On the second level, you must seek out and defeat Taskmaster Kurg and Taskmaster Bellok. If you are playing in hard mode, it is advisable to pull Bellok's group away from the nearby Resurrection Shrine (they will follow quite far); otherwise, a party wipe, will respawn you to close to the enemies and you might easily reach -60% Death Penalty. After Bellok is eliminated, a Dredge Slave will show the way to some Dwarven Powder Kegs to blast through a cracked wall and gain access to the entrance of the dungeon's third level. There is a lever in the southwest of the southeastern chamber which disables the Poison Dart traps; however, it is out of the way. Light of Deldrimor will reveal a Dwarven Ghost near a Beacon of Droknar past the second door opened by the master gear. There is a Hidden Treasure near Taskmaster Kurg.
entries.text: 在第二層，必須找到並擊敗 Taskmaster Kurg 與 Taskmaster Bellok。若以困難模式遊玩，建議將 Bellok 的隊伍引離附近的復活祭壇；他們會追相當遠。否則，全隊陣亡後會在距離敵人過近處復活，很容易反覆死亡並累積到 -60% 死亡懲罰。擊殺 Bellok 後，一名 Dredge Slave 會帶你找到 Dwarven Powder Kegs，用以炸開龜裂的牆壁，通往地監第三層入口。東南方房間的西南側有個拉桿，可關閉毒鏢陷阱，但前往該處需要繞路。通過第二道以 master gear 開啟的門後，使用 Light of Deldrimor，可在 Beacon of Droknar 附近顯現一名 Dwarven Ghost。Taskmaster Kurg 附近另有 Hidden Treasure。
entries.reason: 保留困難模式引離復活祭壇以避免-60%連死；修正拉桿需要繞路，並保留炸牆、第二道齒輪門後與隱藏物的順序位置。

entries.source: More generally, always target the Monk first (see Kurzick Duelist for a guide to identifying the profession of each duelist). An interrupter will make the duel easier as the Monks are very effective, carrying Word of Healing. It's also best to take out the team before the House leader as, being technically a separate party, they can't resurrect their 'team' mates.
entries.text: 一般而言，應始終優先攻擊僧侶；各決鬥者的職業辨識方法可參閱 Kurzick Duelist。僧侶帶有非常有效的「治癒文字」，因此攜帶中斷手段能讓決鬥更容易。也最好先消滅其他隊員，再擊敗家族領袖；依遊戲判定，領袖與隊員屬於不同隊伍，無法互相復活。
entries.reason: 修正 Monk 為僧侶、House 為家族；說明中斷治癒文字與先隊員後領袖的原因，避免誤作同隊可復活。

entries.source: Dying from being crushed does not cause Death Penalty and does not count as a death (for Survivors).
entries.text: 被壓死不會受到死亡懲罰，也不會計入生存者頭銜的死亡紀錄。
entries.reason: 區分死亡懲罰與生存者死亡紀錄；保留被壓死同時不影響兩者的特殊規則。

entries.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.9% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
entries.text: 完整探索此區，約可增加 2.9% 的 Elonian Cartographer 頭銜進度。
entries.reason: 校正探索頭銜進度並保留約2.9%；完整頭銜名無固定中文證據，保留英文。

entries.source: The quest A Perplexing Plague in particular will produce a lot more insect spawns.
entries.text: 尤其是 A Perplexing Plague 任務，會使出現的昆蟲敵人多出許多。
entries.reason: 修正昆蟲產卵為昆蟲敵人出現數量增加；未證實任務中文名保留英文。

entries.source: Start at Piken Square. Head straight to the West and walk along a narrow path on the right. When reaching the marked point you will find several Charr Overseers and Martyrs there. After killing the Overseers first, the Martyrs second and finally the other Charr, you can click on each dead soldier lying on the ground. Each body holds a family crest (needs a slot in your inventory). After collecting 10 of them you can travel back for the reward.
entries.text: 從派肯廣場出發，直接向西走，再沿右側的狹窄小路前進。抵達標記處時，會看到數名 Charr Overseers 與 Martyrs。先殺 Overseers，再殺 Martyrs，最後清除其他夏爾，之後便可點選地上每具士兵屍體。每具屍體各有一枚家徽，每枚都需要一格物品欄空間。收集 10 枚後，即可傳送回去領獎。
entries.reason: 保留 Overseers、Martyrs 與其餘夏爾的優先順序，以及每枚家徽各占一格、共需10枚的條件。

entries.source: Like in pre-Searing Ascalon, however, party members do not suffer Death Penalty, and enemies have reduced health in Reforged Mode.
entries.text: 不過，和崩壞前的阿斯卡隆一樣，隊伍成員不會受到死亡懲罰；在 Reforged Mode 中，敵人的體力也會降低。
entries.reason: 分開保留隊員無死亡懲罰與 Reforged Mode 敵人體力降低；不把模式限定擴大至所有敵人或所有模式。

entries.source: Be careful when accepting the quest reward. When you do, The Fury and his minions will spawn at the location indicated on the map - if General Yendzarsh happens to stand there, they will spawn right next to you. Killing those will spawn a Titan Chest (containing Titan Gemstones), open the path to the City of Torc'qua and progress the quest Mallyx the Unyielding. See there for a walkthrough.
entries.text: 領取任務獎勵時務必小心：一旦領取，The Fury 與其僕從便會在地圖標示的位置出現；若 General Yendzarsh 剛好站在那裡，敵人就會出現在你身旁。擊殺這些敵人後，會出現裝有 Titan Gemstones 的 Titan Chest，開啟通往 City of Torc'qua 的路，並推進 Mallyx the Unyielding 任務。攻略可參閱該任務。
entries.reason: 明確領獎觸發敵人出現、NPC站位造成貼身遇敵；完整保留寶箱內容、開路與另一任務推進的三項結果。

entries.source: You will be attacked by six waves consisting of different types of Destroyers. A new wave starts immediately after the last destroyer of the previous wave has been killed. The party gains a morale boost every time a new wave starts.
entries.text: 你會遭到六波不同種類的 Destroyers 進攻。前一波最後一隻 Destroyer 死亡後，下一波會立即開始。每當新一波開始，隊伍都會獲得士氣提升。
entries.reason: 補譯六波進攻、最後一隻死亡立即換波與每波開始提升士氣，不將敵人出現或士氣誤作一般生成。

entries.source: The second wave consists of Destroyers of Compassion and Destroyers of Deeds. The Destroyers of Deeds block most attacks with Lightning Reflexes, making this the hardest wave for groups consisting mainly of physical damage dealers. They also use Debilitating Shot and Savage Shot, which can incapacitate your casters. Meanwhile, the Destroyers of Compassion will try to wreck your backline. This is one of the more difficult waves. Focus on killing the Destroyers of Compassion first as they deal catastrophic amounts of damage.
entries.text: 第二波由 Destroyers of Compassion 與 Destroyers of Deeds 組成。Destroyers of Deeds 會用「閃電迴避」格擋大多數攻擊，因此以物理傷害為主的隊伍會覺得這波最難應付。牠們也會使用「衰弱之箭」與「野性之箭」，使隊伍中的施法者難以發揮。同時，Destroyers of Compassion 會試圖摧毀後排。這是較難的波次之一；應先集中火力擊殺 Destroyers of Compassion，因為牠們能造成毀滅性的傷害。
entries.reason: 將 Focus 校正為集中火力而非聚能器；保留 Deeds 格擋與壓制施法、Compassion 衝後排及優先擊殺的差別。

entries.source: In the third wave, Destroyers of Hope and Destroyers of Thoughts dig out of the ground throughout the entire arena. If not aggroed, they will circle around the area and attack the Baby Dragon from behind. It is advisable to spread out your party in order to defeat the wave as quickly as possible, being sure to have at least one party member targeting the destroyers on each bridge.
entries.text: 第三波中，Destroyers of Hope 與 Destroyers of Thoughts 會從整個競技場各處的地底鑽出。若未引到牠們，牠們會繞過場地，從後方攻擊 Baby Dragon。建議分散隊伍，以便盡快消滅這波敵人；務必讓每座橋上的 Destroyers 都至少由一名隊員負責攻擊。
entries.reason: 釐清未引到的敵人會繞後攻擊 Baby Dragon；保留全場鑽出與隊伍分散。每座橋上的敵人至少由一名隊員負責攻擊，不額外限定隊員站位。

entries.source: Destroyers are immune to burning and have (at least) +20 armor against fire damage; they have a -20 penalty against cold damage.
entries.text: Destroyers 免疫燃燒，對火焰傷害至少有 +20 防禦；對冰凍傷害則有 -20 防禦。
entries.reason: 完整保留至少+20與-20的屬性防禦差異；不將冰凍傷害的防禦減值泛譯為所有懲罰。

entries.source: Some Deldrimor skills have extra impact against destroyers, especially Alkar's Alchemical Acid.
entries.text: 部分戴爾狄摩技能對 Destroyers 有額外效果，尤其是 Alkar's Alchemical Acid。
entries.reason: 保留部分技能與特別有效技能的限定；使用已核對的戴爾狄摩名稱，其他完整專名保留英文。

entries.source: Display the Stout-Hearted title effect, which increases skill damage against the destroyers (while healing skill users).
entries.text: 啟用 Stout-Hearted 頭銜效果，可提高對 Destroyers 造成的技能傷害，同時為使用技能的角色恢復體力。
entries.reason: 修正 Display 為啟用頭銜效果；明確恢復體力的對象是施技者，而非泛指治療技能或其使用者。

entries.source: Complete exploration of this area will yield about 2.8% to the Canthan Cartographer title track.
entries.text: 完整探索此區，約可增加 2.8% 的 Canthan Cartographer 頭銜進度。
entries.reason: 校正探索頭銜進度並保留約2.8%；完整頭銜名無固定中文證據，保留英文。

entries.source: The herd must be escorted from southeast of the garrison to the entrance of Nundu Bay. First clear the path between the locations of any enemies that normally spawn there. Then talk to Herdsman Mehnosi, at point M on the quest map, to start the herd moving. Two groups of Kournan military, at points K on the quest map, will spawn and attack the herd. The first group attacks just southwest of the garrison and the second group attacks along the path between the garrison and Nundu Bay. Intercept and destroy these groups before they come in range of the cows. Then just wait until the herd reaches its final destination. Go to Herdsman Zekanu at point Z on the quest map for your reward.
entries.text: 必須將牛群從要塞東南方護送到納度灣入口。先清除兩地之間路上原本就會出現的敵人，再與任務地圖 M 點的 Herdsman Mehnosi 交談，讓牛群開始移動。兩群高楠士兵會在任務地圖的 K 點出現並攻擊牛群：第一群在要塞西南方進攻，第二群則在要塞與納度灣之間的路上進攻。趕在敵人接近牛群前攔截並消滅他們，接著等待牛群抵達目的地，再前往任務地圖 Z 點的 Herdsman Zekanu 處領獎。
entries.reason: 保留M、K、Z點與兩次伏擊位置；將牛群攻擊距離誤譯校正為敵人接近牛群前攔截的要求。

entries.source: The Madness of Prophecy quest in particular significantly reduces the number of insect spawns.
entries.text: 尤其是 The Madness of Prophecy 任務，會顯著減少出現的昆蟲敵人數量。
entries.reason: 保留顯著減少而非增加的方向，避免與另兩個增加昆蟲的任務混淆；專名保留英文。

entries.source: If you are not planning on doing any other quests after this or do not mind the death penalty, a quick way back to Rangil is to allow your party to die and respawn at the entrance to Traveler's Vale.
entries.text: 如果接下來不打算進行其他任務，或不介意死亡懲罰，可讓全隊陣亡並在旅人谷入口復活，快速回到 Rangil 身邊。
entries.reason: 保留原文或的條件關係；修正死亡懲罰與入口復活的捷徑，不改成必須同時符合兩條件。

entries.source: Troublesome Flamingos for the quest Flamingo-ing... going... gone. always spawn.
entries.text: 任務 Flamingo-ing... going... gone. 所需的 Troublesome Flamingos 一定會出現。
entries.reason: 保留 always 的保證出現語義；兩個完整專名缺乏固定中文證據，避免以部分詞典拼接。

entries.source: This area contributes approximately 6.88 exploration points towards the Master of the North title track.
entries.text: 探索此區約可取得 6.88 點探索點數，計入 Master of the North 頭銜進度。
entries.reason: 將 title track 校正為頭銜進度；保留6.88的單位是探索點數，沒有誤加百分比。

entries.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.3% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
entries.text: 完整探索此區，約可增加 3.3% 的 Elonian Cartographer 頭銜進度。
entries.reason: 校正探索頭銜進度並保留約3.3%；完整頭銜名未有固定中文證據，保留英文。

entries.source: Death Penalty removers can be helpful; while inside the wurms, it is easy to accumulate 30%-50% DP without noticing.
entries.text: 解除死亡懲罰的手段會很有幫助；待在地蟲體內時，很容易在不知不覺中累積 30%-50% 的死亡懲罰。
entries.reason: 將廢除死刑與亞龍字面誤譯修正為解除死亡懲罰及地蟲；保留30%-50%累積範圍。

entries.source: Sometimes Kepkhet Marrowfeast is hidden at first and won't popup until a party member approaches her spawn point. The Scarab Nest Builders surrounding Kepkhet Marrowfeast won't move if attacked from flatbow or longbow range, so you can cause Kepkhet Marrowfeast to deplete her energy by healing and protecting the Scarab Nest Builder prior to your party engaging Kepkhet Marrowfeast. When you go near Kepkhet Marrowfeast, several Marrow Scarabs will popup. If Kepkhet Marrowfeast casts Mark of Protection on herself, applying a condition or hex will cause her to use Contemplation of Purity and remove Mark of Protection.
entries.text: 柯柏海特食隨者有時一開始會隱藏，直到隊員靠近她的出現位置才現身。以平底弓或長弓的攻擊距離攻擊時，她周圍的 Scarab Nest Builders 不會移動；因此可在隊伍正式接戰前，迫使她不斷治療並保護 Scarab Nest Builder，耗盡她的能量。接近柯柏海特食隨者時，還會突然出現數隻 Marrow Scarabs。若她對自己施放「守護印記」，對她附加病症或降咒，就會使她使用「純淨的冥想」，自行移除「守護印記」。
entries.reason: 釐清治療與保護 Scarab Nest Builder 的施法者是頭目；保留弓距耗能、近身伏兵與誘使自解守護印記的條件。

entries.source: Korshek's group includes several Roaring Ethers and at least one other Djinn. There are also up to three satellite groups, each consisting of more Djinn and Roaring Ethers. In hard mode, Ruby Djinn can hit very hard with Liquid Flame (over 200 damage) and Korshek follows with Searing Flames which can deal over 250 damage against 60 armor rating characters. This means, even with no death penalty, the entire party can be wiped in two to three hits, as these are AoE attacks. Consider getting the Shielding Branches blessing from the Melandru's Watcher outside of Tihark Orchard to reduce the damage caused by Korshek and Ruby Djinn.
entries.text: Korshek 的隊伍有數隻 Roaring Ethers，以及至少一隻其他巨靈怪。周圍還可能有最多三支隊伍，每支都包含更多巨靈怪與 Roaring Ethers。困難模式下，紅寶石巨靈的「液態火焰」可造成超過 200 傷害；Korshek 隨後施放的「爆裂火焰」，對防禦 60 的角色可造成超過 250 傷害。這些都是範圍攻擊，因此即使沒有死亡懲罰，全隊也可能在兩三次命中後全滅。可考慮向 Tihark Orchard 外的 Melandru's Watcher 取得 Shielding Branches 祝福，減輕 Korshek 與紅寶石巨靈的傷害。
entries.reason: 保留至少一隻巨靈、最多三支外圍隊伍與200、250、60數值；還原範圍傷害使無死亡懲罰隊伍仍可能全滅的原因。

entries.source: After obtaining this quest from Hogni Truthseeker in Drakkar Lake, you can map travel to either Longeye's Ledge or Gunnar's Hold. If starting from Longeye's Ledge, travel west until you reach the cave of Tundra Wolves (point 1 on the map). If starting from Gunnar's Hold, travel north to the cave. Along with the wolves will be an Alpha Tundra Wolf. You'll need to defeat all of them in battle in order for them to become allies. Travel south to point 2 on the map where you will be faced with four waves of 3-4 Destroyers, in Hard Mode they will be in larger groups of 4-5. Wait for them to come to you in order to buy a little time between each encounter so you can regenerate health and energy. Take care not to enter the portal to Norrhart Domains while fighting, as in that case you will have to begin again by defeating the wolves. Once you defeat the Destroyers, map travel to Olafstead and head to Hogni Truthseeker to obtain your reward.
entries.text: 在卓卡湖向真實追尋者 霍格尼接取任務後，可使用地圖旅行前往長眼岩脈或甘拿的佔領地。從長眼岩脈出發，就向西走到 Tundra Wolves 的洞穴（地圖 1 點）；從甘拿的佔領地出發，則向北前往洞穴。狼群中還有一隻 Alpha Tundra Wolf。必須在戰鬥中擊敗牠們全部，牠們才會成為盟友。接著向南前往地圖 2 點，迎戰四波、每波 3-4 隻的 Destroyers；困難模式的敵群較大，每波有 4-5 隻。等敵人自行前來，可在兩場戰鬥間多爭取一些恢復體力與能量的時間。戰鬥時小心不要進入通往諾恩之心領地的傳送門，否則必須從擊敗狼群重新開始。消滅 Destroyers 後，使用地圖旅行前往歐拉夫之地，向真實追尋者 霍格尼領獎。
entries.reason: 保留兩個起點的不同方位、地圖1與2點及普通和困難的3-4、4-5規模；明確誤入傳送門必須從狼群重來。

entries.source: If you have trouble retreating through the claws, retreat early and leave a dedicated party member behind to finish the Tendril - he will likely die, but everyone else is safe. Bring Rebirth and a means to remove Death Penalty when using this tactic.
entries.text: 如果難以穿過爪子撤退，就提早撤離，指定一名隊員留下來擊殺 Tendril。這名隊員很可能會死，但其餘人就安全了。使用此戰術時，請攜帶「重生」與解除死亡懲罰的手段。
entries.reason: 將 dedicated party member 校正為指定留下的隊員；保留犧牲風險、提早撤退與重生及解除死亡懲罰的配套。

entries.source: The Kournan military soldiers are of two different levels. Level 16 soldiers are found outside the fort; while level 20 soldiers are found inside or near the fort.
entries.text: 高楠士兵分為兩種等級：堡壘外可見 16 級士兵，堡壘內或附近則有 20 級士兵。
entries.reason: 修正 Kournan military soldiers 的士兵身份；完整保留16級在外、20級在內或附近的位置差別。

entries.source: Elder Jonah can be found at point J on the quest map just outside the southwest exit from the Sunspear Sanctuary. Go with Melonni to each of the quest points. At each one, groups of Corrupted Natures will attack. These groups are small and should pose no threat to a full party. A new group will spawn only after completely destroying the previous one. The final group also contains an Infectious Nightmare.
entries.text: Elder Jonah 位於日戟避難所西南出口外、任務地圖的 J 點。與梅隆妮一同前往各任務標記處；每處都會有 Corrupted Natures 敵群進攻。這些敵群規模不大，對滿員隊伍應不構成威脅。只有完全消滅前一群，下一群才會出現。最後一群還包含一隻 Infectious Nightmare。
entries.reason: 保留梅隆妮必須同行、J點在西南出口外與前群全滅才出下一群；不漏掉最後一群的特殊敵人。

entries.source: Upon completion, speak to Highstone to be awarded 4000 experience points (which will restore 53% of negative morale up to zero which takes care of most Death Penalty). Gather all drops before speaking to him again for Noble Intentions Plan B.
entries.text: 完成後與 Highstone 交談，可獲得 4000 經驗值。這會消除 53 個百分點的負士氣，最多恢復至零，足以清除大部分死亡懲罰。務必先撿完所有掉落物，再次與他交談接取 Noble Intentions Plan B。
entries.reason: 保留4000經驗值與53%的絕對士氣恢復，不誤作將目前負士氣乘以53%；明確先撿掉落再接下一任務。

entries.source: If anyone on the team has the first stage of this quest active Butoh the Bold will not spawn near the Font of Lyss for the primary quest, Attack at the Kodash, to continue.
entries.text: 若隊內任何人仍在進行本任務的第一階段，Butoh the Bold 就不會出現在 Font of Lyss 附近，導致主要任務 Attack at the Kodash 無法繼續。
entries.reason: 保留任一隊員第一階段進行中就阻止NPC出現的條件；明確受阻的是另一個主要任務。

entries.source: Follow the map markers as Erff scouts out various locations in Arbor Bay. The local fauna in the first stage are easily dealt with. However, Erff eventually takes you to the top of a ruined building, where you must defend the party against waves of Destroyers and ultimately, the Shock of Destruction (a Destroyer boss). The destroyers only come from one direction so there is no need to worry about defending the north side of the pyramid too.
entries.text: 跟隨地圖標記，陪 Erff 偵察 Arbor Bay 的各處地點。第一階段的當地野生生物很容易對付。不過，Erff 最後會帶你登上一座廢墟建築頂端；你必須守住隊伍，抵擋數波 Destroyers，最後迎戰 Destroyer 頭目 Shock of Destruction。Destroyers 只從一個方向前來，因此不必同時顧慮金字塔北側的防守。
entries.reason: 修正 Destroyers 與波次進攻；保留偵察後到建築頂部、最終頭目，以及只有一個進攻方向而無須守北側。

entries.source: When the Destroyers approach, position the team just behind the top of the stairs. While the melee attackers will get to you, the rangers will stay on the stairway and attack, but will not be able to hit you. Take out the warriors and any other Destroyer that makes it to the top of the platform and then deal with those below. Pull back from the stairs after each wave to regenerate health and energy.
entries.text: Destroyers 接近時，將隊伍安排在樓梯頂端稍後方。肉搏敵人會走到你面前，但遊俠會留在樓梯上攻擊，卻無法命中你。先消滅戰士與其他登上平台頂端的 Destroyers，再處理下方敵人。每波結束後退離樓梯，恢復體力與能量。
entries.reason: 保留樓梯頂後方使遊俠無法命中的站位；將每次揮手誤譯校正為每波後退回復，並保留上下層擊殺順序。

entries.source: Switch to Stout-Hearted against the destroyers unless your Deldrimor rank is extremely low.
entries.text: 除非戴爾狄摩階級極低，否則對付 Destroyers 時應切換為 Stout-Hearted。
entries.reason: 保留極低階級才例外的條件，明確切換的是頭銜效果而非角色或攻擊目標。

entries.source: Pain Inverter is useful against the boss and the various destroyers.
entries.text: Pain Inverter 對頭目與各種 Destroyers 都很有用。
entries.reason: 保留技能對頭目及各種 Destroyers 的適用範圍；無完整固定中文技能名時保留英文。

entries.source: If you walk to the first island in Arbor Bay without talking to Erff first, the quest will update and say that you have completed the second objective, even though Erff and the Krewe will remain stationary at the entrance to Vlox Falls. Upon reaching the third location, however, you will not be able to complete the quest without having talked to Erff. If you are concerned about the safety of the Krewe, you can have one player stay at the entrance to Vlox Falls, then once the party is in position on the pyramid, the player who stayed behind can talk to Erff to trigger the destroyer spawn, then rejoin the party. Sometimes one of the destroyers will be caught in a rock, requiring nonprojectile damaging spells to kill it.
entries.text: 若未先與 Erff 交談，就走到 Arbor Bay 的第一座島，任務會更新並顯示第二項目標已完成，但 Erff 與研究團隊仍會停在 Vlox Falls 入口。之後抵達第三個地點時，若始終未與 Erff 交談，仍無法完成任務。若擔心研究團隊的安全，可讓一名玩家留在 Vlox Falls 入口；等其他隊員在金字塔上就位後，留下的玩家再與 Erff 交談，觸發 Destroyers 出現，然後歸隊。有時一隻 Destroyer 會卡在岩石中，必須使用能造成傷害的非投射物法術才能擊殺。
entries.reason: 保留誤記第二目標但第三地仍無法完成的狀態；明確留下玩家交談觸發與非投射物傷害法術處理卡怪。

entries.source: This can give easy experience for the Survivor title track. Simply getting the gelatin via trade and turning it in gives lots of experience without risk of death.
entries.text: 這是輕鬆累積生存者頭銜所需經驗值的方法。只要透過交易取得凝膠（gelatin）並交付，就能在沒有死亡風險的情況下獲得大量經驗值。
entries.reason: 修正體驗與主打歌為經驗值及頭銜進度；保留交易取得後交付的免死亡風險方法，凝膠另附原文以避免假定官方物品名。

entries.source: Scavenge the wilderness for Screecher and Scratcher. Kill them to reduce harpy morale.
entries.text: 在野外搜尋 Screecher 與 Scratcher，擊殺牠們以降低鷹身女妖的士氣。
entries.reason: 保留 Screecher 與 Scratcher 為兩個不同目標，避免都譯成尖叫者；明確擊殺會降低鷹身女妖士氣。

entries.source: Even with this careful approach, you will likely find that the Margonites attack in waves of 3 groups (so 2 waves on each of the north and south sides to make the total 12 groups). Do note that there are 4 different kinds of groups. The first group at the east are mostly rangers. The 2nd at the east side are melee. The 2 groups on the west side are both casters and melee.
entries.text: 即使採用上述謹慎的打法，瑪骨奈仍很可能每波以 3 群進攻；北、南兩側各有 2 波，總共 12 群。注意，敵群分為 4 種：東側第一群以遊俠為主，東側第 2 群是肉搏敵人，西側 2 群則都混有施法者與肉搏敵人。
entries.reason: 保留每波3群、南北各2波共12群與4種類型；將 casters 校正為施法者，明確東西兩側組成差異。

entries.source: Temple Guardians have less armor rating against cold damage, so consider bringing Winter or skills that deal cold damage. Consider bringing Water Magic hex spells that snare and deal cold damage (i.e. Deep Freeze, Ice Spikes, Mind Freeze, and Shard Storm), which will slow their movement speed and can help in preventing them from reaching your midline/backline and dealing point blank area of effect damage from Temple Guardians' Double Dragon and Quansong Spiritspeak's Ancestors' Rage.
entries.text: Temple Guardians 對冰凍傷害的防禦較低，因此可考慮攜帶「寒冬」或造成冰凍傷害的技能。也可攜帶同時減速並造成冰凍傷害的水系降咒魔法，例如「強力凍結」、「冰之尖刺」、「心靈凍結」與「冰風暴」。降低敵人移動速度，有助於阻止牠們接近中排與後排，避免 Temple Guardians 的「雙龍」及通靈者 魁嵩的「先人的盛怒」在其自身周圍造成範圍傷害。
entries.reason: 修正 snare 為減速、point blank area 為以自身為中心的範圍；保留低冰防與四種水系技能如何阻止敵人貼近中後排的因果。

entries.source: Best if using Henchmen to start in Ran Musu Gardens, that way your henchmen will be level 10 where as starting in Tsumei Village your Henchmen will be level 6. Start in Ran Musu Gardens, go down through Kinya Province to Panjiang Peninsula to keep henchmen at level 10. Kill Tahkayun Tsi to give your party a morale boost, as he is right outside of the exit from Ran Musu Gardens. Head down towards Port Kaimu where Captain Quimang is, killing the groups on both sides of where the Captain is, but staying away from contact with him. Then head to the farming village (Kaitan Village) just outside Tsumei Village starting from as far south as you can go working north and you'll end up with 9 level 10 guards to help you with the final group and Captain Quimang.
entries.text: 若使用傭兵，最好從嵐穆蘇花園出發；這樣傭兵會是 10 級，若從蘇梅村出發則只有 6 級。從嵐穆蘇花園經欣彌領地下到班讓半島，可讓傭兵維持 10 級。先擊殺就在嵐穆蘇花園出口外的 Tahkayun Tsi，為隊伍取得士氣提升。接著往 Captain Quimang 所在的 Port Kaimu 前進，清除隊長兩側的敵群，但不要接觸他。然後前往蘇梅村外的農村 Kaitan Village，從能抵達的最南端向北推進；最後會有 9 名 10 級守衛，協助你迎戰最後一群敵人與 Captain Quimang。
entries.reason: 修正9名10級守衛的數量與等級，避免顛倒；保留10級對6級傭兵、行經路線、先避隊長與由南向北招守衛。

entries.source: To get the dungeon key to drop, you must kill the Reaper of Destruction and the group of hidden destroyers at the Reaper's initial location.
entries.text: 必須擊殺 Reaper of Destruction，以及牠起始位置的隱藏 Destroyers 敵群，才會掉落地監鑰匙。
entries.reason: 保留兩者都必須擊殺的掉落條件；明確隱藏敵群在頭目起始位置，不改成只殺頭目或任一敵群。
